components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for search, contact, submit, and active decisions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary framed action for reset, back, and alternate commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); transition: background 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Search and form input with stable 44px mobile-friendly height.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 40%, transparent), 0 0 0 4px var(--background); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact listing state badge for available, reserved, sold, and off-plan status.
components.css: .ds-badge-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; width: fit-content; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); transition: box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-badge-status:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-badge-status:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Golden Visa Badge
components.description: Rare amber eligibility cue for UAE residency qualification.
components.css: .ds-badge-golden { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fffbeb, #fef3c7); color: #92400e; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-badge-golden:hover { border-color: #fbbf24; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-badge-golden:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(251 191 36 / 0.35); }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); padding: 1.5rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-card:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 35%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-property-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20rem minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 18rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); transition: transform 300ms ease-out, box-shadow 300ms ease-out; } .ds-property-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-property-media { min-height: 16rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--muted), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 18%, var(--muted))); } .ds-property-content { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-property-price { margin: 0; color: var(--primary); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-property-content h3 { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-property-copy { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-property-meta { width: fit-content; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-property-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.name: Filter Toggle Row
components.description: Advanced filter row for Golden Visa and binary refinement controls.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--background); padding: 0.75rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-row:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-toggle-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: rgb(245 158 11 / 0.10); color: #b45309; } .ds-toggle-copy { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-toggle-copy strong { color: var(--foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-toggle-copy small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: 2rem; height: 1.15rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary); padding: 0.075rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-switch span { display: block; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary-foreground); transform: translateX(0.75rem); transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-row:focus-within { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 40%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Dubai Property IQ should feel like a calm advisory workspace for high-value Dubai real estate decisions. The interface is premium because it is clear, disciplined, and data-aware, not because it is ornamental. The product should make property discovery, area research, developer review, calculators, and enquiry actions feel connected inside one trustworthy intelligence layer.

The physical scene is a buyer or investor comparing listings on a laptop in daylight, then checking the same shortlist on mobile between viewings. That scene points to a light, blue-tinted product system with compact hierarchy, stable controls, strong focus states, and restrained motion. Admin screens can be denser, but they should still inherit the same clarity and token discipline.

The system rejects aggressive brutalism, heavy gradients, playful rounded controls, excessive shadows, generic SaaS decoration, fake-glass surfaces, cluttered listing-portal layouts, and luxury clichés such as dark navy-and-gold overload. If the UI delays search, comparison, or decision support for decorative impact, it is off-brand.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-tinted neutrality, not plain white or black.
Compact hierarchy for search, filters, property cards, calculators, and dashboards.
Subtle depth only where it clarifies state or grouping.
Amber used only for Golden Visa and luxury eligibility moments.

rules.name: The Amber Rarity Rule
rules.body: Amber is reserved for Golden Visa and eligibility significance. If amber appears on a generic button, chart, empty state, or marketing flourish, remove it.

rules.name: The Blue Trust Rule
rules.body: Primary blue guides action and decision: search, contact, active state, price emphasis, focus, and selected filters. Do not use it as broad decoration.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never use pure black or pure white for product surfaces. Neutrals stay slightly blue-tinted so the product remains premium and cohesive.

rules.name: The Comparison First Rule
rules.body: Prices, locations, amenities, developer signals, and eligibility information must remain more legible than decorative headings.

rules.name: The No Hero Inside Tools Rule
rules.body: Product workflows use compact hierarchy. Save display scale for true page-level context only.

rules.name: The Flat Until Useful Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are quiet. Add shadow only when it improves grouping, affordance, or hover feedback.

rules.name: The No Floating Stack Rule
rules.body: Do not nest cards or stack multiple framed containers to manufacture depth.

dos: Do use the existing OKLCH token system in app/(frontend)/globals.css for public product UI.
Do keep property discovery decisive: price, location, eligibility, amenities, and search refinement should be immediately scannable.
Do use primary blue for action, focus, active state, price emphasis, selected filters, and enquiry actions.
Do preserve 44px touch targets on mobile search, filters, pagination, and contact controls.
Do use borders and tonal surfaces before adding more shadow.
Do keep calculator outputs and schedules aligned, compact, and readable.
Do keep explanatory copy short, concrete, and close to the control or property data it supports.
Do keep Golden Visa cues amber and rare.
donts: Don't use fake-glass surfaces as a default treatment.
Don't create cluttered listing-portal layouts that make comparison feel noisy.
Don't make the product feel like a cheap lead-generation site.
Don't use dark navy-and-gold overload as a luxury shortcut.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored side-stripe accent.
Don't turn search pages, calculators, property detail pages, or admin screens into marketing landing pages.
